$comment: Thin-P9 motion template v1. The commercial story is a virtualization displacement; the RULE is keyed on the renewal and lifecycle predicates this product actually holds. Which platform is installed is NOT claimed — `technology_in_use` holds no facts, so it is declared as missing context instead of asserted.
name: Datacenter modernization and virtualization displacement
objective: Convert a dated virtualization estate into a modernization evaluation, timed against a contract or lifecycle event the account is already facing.

motion_v1.objective: Convert a dated virtualization estate into a modernization evaluation, timed against a contract or lifecycle event the account is already facing.

requires.because: a renewal inside the next year is the moment a modernization alternative can actually be considered

disqualifiers.because: an account under a declared budget reduction is not a migration conversation this year

requiresContext: Which virtualization platform is installed — `technology_in_use` holds no observations, so the estate is not asserted.
Support lifecycle position of the installed estate — `end_of_support_date` is available as a predicate but unobserved here.
Whether a competing modernization purchase has already been made.
motion_v1.goalTemplate: Determine whether {{company}} will evaluate a modernization alternative ahead of its renewal, and what would have to be true for that evaluation to happen.
motion_v1.campaignGuidance: Anchor on the renewal date the account already knows about. Offer a comparison of what modernizing would cost against what renewing costs — never a migration pitch before that arithmetic exists.
measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened or advanced on this account after application — association only.
A recorded renewal outcome on the account.

cta.fallback: Written benchmark of how comparable estates approached the same renewal

seller_cadence.action: Confirm the renewal date and who owns the decision
Technical discovery on the installed estate with a solution architect
Joint recommendation with the partner who would deliver the migration
